gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono reads like nails lined up along a ruler. Snowburst One is stencil-cut and loud, with slight swelling in its bowls, while the monospace body keeps no stroke contrast, and that gap defines the pair.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-geist-mono: Geist Mono reads like fixed-width code, with lowercase that rises high and big gaps at the sides of every letter. Under Snowburst One's stencil heading, paragraphs would tick along like a typewriter.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-genos: Snowburst One is a stencil sheet with wide bridges between letters. Genos, pressed tight with a middle path between monoline and hairline strokes, gives that bold display heading a sans-serif body that never snags.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-inder: Stencil-cut and loud, Snowburst One leaves wide bridges between its letters. Inder keeps its capitals and lowercase close in height, a quiet sans that lets the heading do the talking.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-jaldi: Jaldi looks brushed on, with barely a gap between letters. Its x-height sits well above the usual and its c gapes at any size, so paragraphs stay open and readable beneath Snowburst One's stencil heading.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-kdam-thmor-pro: Expressive is the word for Snowburst One's stencil heading. Kdam Thmor Pro brings a contemporary sans-serif whose bowls fill the line, and the stencil display heading gains a modern partner.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-krona-one: Approachable describes Krona One, loosely spaced and sturdy as cast iron. Text would roll out in weighty, loosely spaced letters, a sans-serif counterweight to the stencil boldness of Snowburst One's heading.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-magra: Snowburst One is all stencil bridges and tall lowercase, built to make a bold entrance. But Magra, a sans with big-bodied lowercase words, is built for the quieter job of carrying text.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-mitr: Snowburst One is the stencil showpiece, bold with tall lowercase. Mitr handles the other job: a sans-serif with very little gap between lowercase and capital height, which keeps text compact and approachable.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-momo-trust-displ: Wide stencil bridges and tall lowercase: that is Snowburst One. Momo Trust Display drifts its letters apart and stands on a generous x-height, a spacious, clean counterpart to the heading.
